disposition: Bounded streaming is proven: family streams reuse bounded family readers, memory stays bounded under a non-draining consumer, backpressure never blocks an engine commit, cancellation closes promptly without leaked locks or buffers, and the attachment plane enforces explicit limits (64 KiB segments, 8 MiB content ceiling) with typed over-limit errors; no huge-file/stress-scale attachment test exists (V1 BigFiles/HugeFiles; the 8 MiB V2 ceiling is an explicit refusal with no charter decision), and position/partial-consumption semantics are only partially asserted.
